query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM skills WHERE project_id IS NULL AND (id < $2) AND ($2 IS NOT NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM skills WHERE project_id IS NULL AND ($2 IS NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $1) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $3 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN skill_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
